_comment_version: Do not change the version number! It is used for automatic config updates.
_comment_xp: How much experience points a player gets for submitting a single new item.
_comment_interval: How often (every X items) the player receives a milestone reward.
_comment_milestones: Loot pool for milestone rewards. 'weight' determines the chance of dropping (higher = more common).
_comment_categories: Rewards given for completing an entire tab (100%). Default fallback is 'modded_generic'.
